summary: Captures system-wide audio or specific application window audio natively using CoreAudio process taps (macOS Sonoma+).

ports.name: Active
ports.text: True to start the audio capture tap, false to stop it.

ports.name: Capture Type
ports.text: Choose to capture system sound (System Audio Capture) or specific application process audio (Window Audio Capture).

ports.name: Source
ports.text: Select the target screen/system or window from the dynamically populated list.

ports.name: Volume
ports.text: Volume multiplier applied to the captured audio node (0-1).

ports.name: Refresh
ports.text: Manually triggers a query to update the available windows list.

ports.name: Audio Node
ports.text: Outputs the captured stereo audio stream as a Web Audio Node compatible object.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Text status indicating capture states: Stopped, Capturing, Permission Denied, or Error.
